meta.title: Button and serial monitor
meta.blurb: A button on pin 2 with the internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP), a 30 ms debounce in code, and a count on Serial.
see: Open CODE and the serial monitor: "Ready" prints at start.
Each click of the button prints "Press 1", "Press 2" and so on; the L LED shows the button state.
No resistor is needed: the pin pulls itself up to 5 V and the button pulls it to ground.
